payload.title: Make paid rendering and fallback policy explicit
payload.description:
## Behavior and acceptance
Given an author submitting work to Babulus, when paid cloud fallback is enabled, then configured limits and pricing/estimate policy are visible before submission. Local-only mode never silently falls back to paid rendering. Record local versus cloud execution and usage for billing; define commercial pricing separately rather than inventing it in implementation.

## Ownership
Babulus rendering platform; VideoML public project/artifact contract

## Verification
Specify Given/When/Then fixtures before implementation and link results before closing. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.
